title: First Day on the Danfo
brief: Dawn at Oshoja. Shina Garage's boys came for the levy again. Baba Driver has work for whoever can count change.
standout: Your first shift as a conductor: three stops, fares, change, and the agbero.

objectives.sub: E for the next line, F to skip

say.speaker: Oshoja, dawn
lines: Shina's boy: Mama, the levy na three hundred and fifty. Your husband's own.
Iya Tobi: Femi don die. Wetin you wan make I sell again?
Shina's boy: Shina say Friday. After Friday we no go knock.
Iya Tobi: Tunde... no follow them talk. Go find Baba Driver for the park.
Tunde: I go find the money, Mama. I swear.

objectives.sub: Meet him at the motor park
